sport_summary: NBA Playoffs action headlines a loaded Wednesday slate featuring 4 NBA games and 9 MLB contests across both leagues

picks.reasoning: The market has settled firmly at 7.5 across most books, but BetMGM is offering the best price on the 76ers at -106 for the cover. Philadelphia has enough offensive firepower to keep this competitive, and getting a team at nearly a touchdown in a playoff environment offers strong value on the dog side.

San Antonio is priced as massive moneyline favorites ranging from -395 to -435, yet the spread sits at a very manageable -9.5 at DraftKings and BetMGM. The line discrepancy between the ML implied probability and the spread suggests the market expects a dominant Spurs performance, making -9.5 the right side to be on at standard juice.

The total is consistently set at 216.5 across the majority of books with the Under priced at -108 on DraftKings, representing the best available price. Playoff basketball tends to tighten defensively, and with the Knicks playing at home where pace often slows, the Under presents solid value at this number.

Los Angeles is a consensus -200 to -230 favorite across all nine books, and LowVig.ag offers the best value at -204 with reduced juice. The Dodgers' elite pitching depth and lineup construction make them a strong play in a game with a relatively modest total of 8.5, implying a well-pitched, low-scoring affair that favors the better team.

The Yankees are listed as heavy -191 to -230 moneyline favorites, yet FanDuel is offering the run line at +104 — meaning you get paid to take New York to win by 2 or more. A team priced this heavily to win should be expected to win convincingly, and getting plus money on a dominant favorite's run line is exceptional value.

The total of 7.5 sits at the lowest number on the board today, and LowVig.ag offers the Under at just -103, which is the sharpest juice available across all books. Both Tampa Bay and Toronto have been pitching-first teams, and a total this low with near-flat juice on the Under signals strong market consensus toward a low-scoring game.

FanDuel offers the Over at 216.5 for -105 while LowVig and BetOnline have moved their total up to 217.5, suggesting upward pressure on the number. This half-point of line shopping advantage combined with the -105 price makes FanDuel the optimal book to grab this total before it moves further, as both teams' offensive capabilities support a high-scoring affair.
